question: Does the paired finite-horizon stable-concurrency harness track real input completion, and do twelve sessions occupy four three-member groups?

configuration_profile.type: Functional GPU check, not performance evaluation
configuration_profile.profile_limit_override: max_sessions set to target concurrency; costs are deliberately uncalibrated functional inputs

change: Fixed sample-count frames with input identity spanning gateway, worker and actual EngineCore model completion.
Source-clock input readiness fixes deadlines independently of delayed arrival/release; missing and never-submitted frames remain in denominator.
Admission barrier, full drain, per-session sliding miss/lag checks and explicit pass/fail/invalid classification.
Paired matched_resident_control shares worker, gateway and schedule settings while removing all KV offload; it is not unchanged Metronome.
Capacity CLI performs fresh-worker repeated paired sweeps and reports maximum tested stable with a tested failure bracket.
Planner reserves sum of full group member eviction ceilings in a shared window; actual safe amount can grow to cap. Late first input retains initial backing reservation.

metrics.metric: engine-observed compute completion by next planned release
engine-observed compute completion by next planned release

result.aggregate: Both systems pass the one tested point; no next tested failure, so no capacity maximum established.
result.regressions: 115 root tests passed, 3 skipped, 28 subtests passed; includes Go race tests, reverse free-queue/hash mapping, full-ceiling group admission, dropped input/deadline immutability and invalid-boundary checks.

remaining_uncertainty: Formal costs and SLO must be frozen; no high-pressure long-duration multi-seed capacity matrix has been run.
General heterogeneous re-planning and group-wide restoration allocation are not implemented by this bounded per-session policy.
Native variable-length duplex audio output requires separate termination/delivery events; this check is fixed-cap Thinker-only.
Temporary functional-check directories and dependent aggregate removed under user retention discipline.
